releaseNotes:
🚀 Update System Introduction

Improved update handling and release verification for a more reliable app experience.

⚡ Performance Improvements

Optimized release loading and scrolling with real GitHub API pagination. Releases now load in smaller batches of 5 for a smoother experience.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Stability

Improved pagination reliability, caching, and duplicate request prevention for more consistent release handling.

✨ Additional Improvements

Enhanced build verification and overall release handling for better stability.
